notes.title: Demo Update 4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Music! Demo now has some ambient space music
[*] Added "Display" in options: players with multiple monitors can now pick which screen to move the game to
[*] Added 2 new "protect the outpost" stats
[*] Added defaults for options in case they cannot be loaded
[*] Adjusted mouse dragging and mouse zoom speeds
[*] Fixed audio rate miss-match
[*] Audio balancing
[*] Menu audio switched to non-positional
[*] Removed unused files
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated code base to Godot version 4.4
[*] Moved countdown to the HUD layer so it is visible no matter what the zoom level is at
[*] Cleaned up keys help window in the mining mission
[*] Fixed a bug where mining drones do not deselect when picking target asteroid
[*] Added defaults to options: the demo will now start at 1280x720 windowed in the center of the primary monitor. Players can then go to the options menu to fine tune graphics settings further
[*] In windowed mode, the game window can be resized to whatever size needed allowing more casual play while working on other things
[*] Fixed a bug where fog percentage was going slightly over 100% due to floating point error
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.content:
Converted a few popups into dialogue text for time saving
Removed check that would end mining scenario when asteroids were no longer present
End stats are now saved across sessions
Removed delays due to animations and popups
